input.text: Every month I export invoices to CSV and paste totals into a spreadsheet by hand, which takes a whole Saturday.
It would be great if the export had a filter for unpaid invoices.
Is there a way to reconcile the payments automatically?
None of these apps are any good.
The vendor portal posts a PDF statement on the first of the month.
The cafe downstairs is closed for renovation this week.
